name: Sharecare (2nd Position)
desc:
Records Coordinator (Medical Records) | Est. $17/hr | Medical Records Data Entry, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sharecare
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Sharecare is a digital healthcare company, and one of the things it does is handle medical records for hospitals and doctor's offices. In this role, you'll log in to different electronic medical records systems and accurately type patient information into Sharecare's software. You'll also provide customer service when needed. Privacy is a big part of the job. You'll make sure only authorized people get access to patient information and that every release of records follows the request, the patient's authorization, company policy, and HIPAA rules. Experience is helpful but not required, because they will train you.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Reliability
- Organization
- Self-motivation
- Respect for privacy
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. Likely includes a typing test since 50+ WPM is required.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: None. Medical records office experience is helpful but not required, and they will train.
Preferred Experience: Medical records office experience

Required Skills:
- Type 50+ words per minute accurately
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel
- Focused on high-quality work
- Self-motivated team player
- Excellent organization
- Extremely reliable
- Detail-oriented
- Keep a yearly HIPAA certification

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Types fast and accurately and likes focused computer work
- Wants to get into healthcare with no experience
- Is careful about privacy and following rules
- Prefers working on their own over talking on the phone all day

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Types under 50 WPM
- Gets bored with repetitive data entry
- Struggles with accuracy
- Wants a job with lots of people contact
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Data entry
- Medical records
- Electronic medical records (EMR)
- HIPAA compliance
- Release of information
- Typing speed and accuracy
- Microsoft Word and Excel
- Patient privacy
- Attention to detail
- Customer service

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- What's your typing speed, and how do you keep your accuracy high?
- Tell us about any experience you have with medical records or data entry.
- What would you do if a records request was missing a patient's signed authorization?
- Tell us about a time you caught a mistake in your own work. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had a lot of repetitive work to finish. How did you stay focused, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $16 to $19/hr, working estimate $17/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. This estimate is based on salary site data for medical records coordinators (median about $17.65/hr) and similar remote medical records coordinator postings around $19/hr.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a true entry-level, no-phone healthcare job, and Sharecare will train. The main bar is typing 50+ words per minute accurately, so have participants take a typing test first. You must keep a yearly HIPAA certification. The posting lists lifting up to 25 pounds, which is unusual for a remote role, so participants can ask about it. Sharecare uses E-Verify. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Records Coordinator → ROI Medical Records Specialist → Senior ROI Specialist → Lead ROI Specialist → Health Information Management Supervisor. Sharecare posts ROI Specialist and Lead ROI Specialist roles, so there's a real ladder. This role builds medical records, HIPAA, and data accuracy skills.
